title: New Photo Studio Template Tutorial | Unreal Engine 5.7
description: A focused walkthrough of the Unreal Engine 5.7 Photo Studio Template designed for high-end visualization. This tutorial breaks down the template’s render settings, including Lumen GI, reflections, locked exposure, and Path Tracing, and explains how they support automotive, product, and portfolio workflows. It also covers what’s included in the template and how to extend it with your own assets for consistent, high-quality results.
